host.ask: IP address or host name of the incubator's Modbus TCP interface (or gateway)
host.help: Shown on the incubator's touchscreen under Settings / Setup / network when the Modbus option is fitted, or the address of the serial-to-Modbus-TCP gateway in front of its RS-232/USB data interface. Port 502 is assumed; put `port` in config.json if yours differs. For Modbus RTU over a serial port use `serial_port` and `baud` instead of `host`.

unit.help: 1 unless the controller or gateway was configured otherwise.
